revisions.purpose: Add invited-member email/password access with fixed-project Firebase actions and server-verified membership, owner-only invitation management, and per-note manual evidence walkthroughs. Passwords go only to Google; app tokens and private notes remain in memory. Clear email-action capabilities before other resources load, prohibit action URLs from offline caches, and retain GitHub owner administration. Shared scientific functions, initializer order, candidate predictions and progress data are unchanged.

scripts_changed.position: first script in head, before styles and other executable resources

revisions.configuration_policy: team-auth-config.js contains only public API/Firebase project identifiers. It is parsed in the exact reviewed load order but remains independently configurable. No service-account keys, private notes or app-session tokens are bundled.
controls_preserved: complete function and initializer AST comparison
all prior reviewed revision records with ordered counts and complete content hashes
candidate predictions and five-fold probability ranges
fixed callback error messages without reflecting provider text or secrets
fixed Firebase project and Worker route allowlists
server-verified membership and owner-only team administration
no password, identity token, session token or private memo in browser storage
email action URL stripping and no-referrer policy
manual private-note animation with reduced motion and cleanup
